component: superpowers-core — core process pipeline (v6.2.0 at /home/eranr/.claude/plugins/cache/superpowers-dev/superpowers/6.2.0/skills/; v6.1.1 sibling is an older revision of the same six skills)

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.purpose: Meta-skill that forces skill lookup and invocation before any response or action in every conversation.
skills.mechanism: Hard rule: invoke any skill with even 1% relevance BEFORE clarifying questions or exploration; a 12-row 'Red Flags' rationalization table pre-empts excuses; process skills outrank implementation skills; per-platform reference files (codex/pi/gemini/antigravity-tools.md) map abstract actions ('dispatch a subagent', 'create a todo') to each harness's concrete tools; SUBAGENT-STOP block exempts dispatched subagents; user instructions explicitly outrank skills.
skills.invocation: auto — loaded at start of every conversation; also mandates brainstorming before plan mode

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.purpose: Turns an idea into an approved, committed design spec through one-question-at-a-time dialogue before any implementation.
skills.mechanism: HARD-GATE: no code, scaffolding, or implementation skill until design is presented and user-approved, regardless of perceived simplicity; 9-item checklist each becoming a todo (explore context → clarifying questions one per message → 2-3 approaches with recommendation → section-by-section design approval → spec written to docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md and committed → inline self-review for placeholders/contradictions/scope/ambiguity → user review gate → invoke writing-plans); process encoded as a graphviz state machine; sole legal terminal state is invoking writing-plans; oversized requests get decomposed into sub-projects first.
skills.invocation: model-invoked, mandatory before any creative/build work

skills.name: brainstorming/visual-companion (reference + scripts)
skills.purpose: Optional browser-based companion for showing mockups, diagrams, and clickable A/B/C options during brainstorming.
skills.mechanism: Local Node server (scripts/server.cjs) serves newest HTML fragment from screen_dir wrapped in a frame template; user clicks are logged as JSONL to state_dir/events which the agent reads next turn and merges with terminal feedback; key-gated URL; offered just-in-time as its own message only when a question is genuinely visual, with a per-question browser-vs-terminal decision rule.
skills.invocation: model-offered mid-brainstorm only after user accepts; never upfront

skills.name: brainstorming/spec-document-reviewer-prompt (agent template)
skills.purpose: Subagent template that reviews a written spec for readiness before planning.
skills.mechanism: Checks completeness/consistency/clarity/scope/YAGNI with a calibration block ('only flag issues that would cause real problems'); returns Status Approved|Issues Found plus non-blocking recommendations.
skills.invocation: model-dispatched as a subagent after spec is written (optional; 6.2.0 SKILL.md favors inline self-review)

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.purpose: Converts an approved spec into an implementation plan a zero-context executor can follow step by step.
skills.mechanism: Plans assume the executor knows nothing of the codebase: mandatory header (Goal/Architecture/Global Constraints copied verbatim from spec), per-task Files list and Consumes/Produces interface block, checkbox steps of 2-5 minutes each containing literal code and exact commands; a 'No Placeholders' ban list (TBD, 'add error handling', 'similar to Task N' are plan failures); self-review pass for spec coverage, placeholder scan, and cross-task type consistency; saved to docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<name>.md; ends by offering execution handoff (subagent-driven recommended vs inline executing-plans).
skills.invocation: model-invoked as brainstorming's required next step

skills.name: writing-plans/plan-document-reviewer-prompt (agent template)
skills.purpose: Subagent template verifying a plan is complete, spec-aligned, and buildable.
skills.mechanism: Checks completeness, spec alignment, task decomposition, buildability against the spec file; calibrated to flag only implementation-blocking issues; returns Approved|Issues Found plus advisory recommendations.
skills.invocation: model-dispatched subagent after the plan is written (optional)

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.purpose: Inline (no-subagent) execution of a written plan with review checkpoints and strict stop-and-ask rules.
skills.mechanism: Load plan → review it critically and raise concerns before starting → todo per task → follow bite-sized steps exactly, run every verification → hand off to finishing-a-development-branch; hard stop rules on blockers, unclear instructions, or repeated verification failure ('ask rather than guess'); requires isolated worktree and forbids starting on main without consent; self-deprecates in favor of subagent-driven-development when subagents exist.
skills.invocation: model-invoked when executing a plan without subagent support or in a separate session

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.purpose: Controller loop that executes a plan by dispatching a fresh implementer subagent per task with a two-stage independent review after each and a whole-branch review at the end.
skills.mechanism: Per-plan git-ignored workspace (scripts/sdd-workspace) holds an append-only progress ledger that survives context compaction (first line names the plan; completion/fix-round/parked entries are the recovery map); scripts/task-brief and scripts/review-package hand context to subagents as file paths so nothing large enters controller context; implementers return a 4-status contract (DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS/BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT) in under 15 lines with detail in a report file; reviewer gives dual verdicts (spec compliance + quality) and must distrust the implementer's report; fix loop capped at 5 rounds (rounds 1-3 resume the same implementer, 4-5 fresh implementer on a stronger model), each round ends in a scoped re-review verdicting each finding ADDRESSED/NOT ADDRESSED; at the cap a breaker forces per-finding adjudication — park with a written ruling or STOP as BLOCKED — with silent discards forbidden; explicit model tiering per role (cheap for transcription, capable for final review) and continuous execution with no between-task check-ins; ends in finishing-a-development-branch.
skills.invocation: model-invoked when a plan with independent tasks is executed in-session with subagent support

skills.name: subagent-driven-development/implementer-prompt (agent template)
skills.purpose: Template for the per-task implementer subagent.
skills.mechanism: Reads its brief file as sole requirements source; explicitly invited to ask questions before and during work; escalation section normalizes saying 'this is too hard' (BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT, no penalty); mandatory self-review (completeness/quality/discipline/testing) before reporting; writes full report with TDD evidence to a report file and returns only the short status contract.
skills.invocation: controller-dispatched, one fresh instance per task, model chosen per tiering rules

skills.name: subagent-driven-development/task-reviewer-prompt (agent template)
skills.purpose: Template for the independent per-task reviewer giving spec-compliance and quality verdicts.
skills.mechanism: Reads brief + implementer report + a pre-built diff file in one call; 'Do Not Trust the Report' section treats implementer claims and rationales as unverified; checks Missing/Extra/Misunderstood vs spec, plus quality/tests/structure; '⚠️ Cannot verify from diff' items route back to the controller instead of widening the search; severity calibration (Critical/Important/Minor) with plan-mandated defects still reportable; output is verdict-only, no preamble.
skills.invocation: controller-dispatched after each implementer DONE, never skipped

skills.name: subagent-driven-development/re-review-prompt (agent template)
skills.purpose: Template for the scoped re-review after each fix round.
skills.mechanism: Verdicts each prior finding ADDRESSED/NOT ADDRESSED with file:line evidence ('attempted is not addressed'); inspects only the fix diff for new breakage; anything outside the fix diff goes to non-blocking Out-of-Scope Observations so the loop can never wander or grow.
skills.invocation: controller-dispatched once per fix round on a cheap-to-mid model

skills.name: subagent-driven-development/scripts (sdd-workspace, task-brief, review-package)
skills.purpose: Bash helpers that materialize per-plan artifacts as files so subagent context is constructed, not inherited.
skills.mechanism: sdd-workspace prints a plan-scoped git-ignored dir (prevents cross-plan ledger contamination); task-brief extracts one task's text from the plan via awk to a brief file; review-package writes commit list + stat + full -U10 diff for a recorded BASE..HEAD range to a uniquely named file (never HEAD~1, which drops multi-commit tasks).
skills.invocation: run by the controller at setup, before each dispatch, and before each review

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.purpose: Pattern for dispatching one subagent per independent problem domain to work concurrently.
skills.mechanism: Decision digraph tests independence and shared state; each agent prompt must be focused, self-contained, constrained ('do NOT change other code'), and specify an output contract; multiple dispatch calls in one response run in parallel, one per response is sequential; integration step reviews summaries, checks conflicts, runs the full suite, and spot-checks for systematic errors.
skills.invocation: model-invoked when 2+ tasks are independent with no shared state; explicitly not for related failures or exploratory debugging

patterns: Hard gates at phase boundaries: no downstream work until the current phase's artifact is explicitly human-approved (design gate, spec review gate), with an anti-pattern section pre-refuting 'too simple to need this'
Single-terminal-state pipeline: each skill names exactly one legal successor (brainstorm → writing-plans → executing/SDD → finish), so the process is a linked chain, not a menu
Rationalization tables: enumerate the exact excuses the model will generate ('close enough', 'I'll fix it myself', 'skip the re-review') and rebut each one inline
Zero-context handoff: downstream artifacts written for a reader with no shared history — exact values verbatim, literal content, an explicit No-Placeholders ban list treated as artifact failure
Consumes/Produces interface blocks so isolated workers learn neighboring tasks' contracts without seeing the whole plan
Append-only ledger file as durable memory that survives context compaction, with an identity first line, resumability rules, and 'trust the ledger and git over your own recollection'

Context hygiene via files: briefs, reports, and review packages passed as file paths generated by scripts, never pasted into the coordinator's context; subagents return a short fixed-status contract with detail in the report file

Fresh-eyes adversarial review: an independent reviewer with clean context who is instructed to distrust the worker's self-report and give dual verdicts (requirement compliance AND quality); worker self-review never substitutes
Scoped re-review: per-finding ADDRESSED/NOT-ADDRESSED verdicts over only the fix delta; out-of-scope observations are deferred to a ledger, structurally preventing loop creep

Bounded fix loop with escalation ladder: resume the same worker for rounds 1-3, fresh worker on a stronger model for 4-5, then a breaker forcing explicit per-finding adjudication (park with written ruling, or STOP if load-bearing) — silent discards forbidden
No pre-judging reviewers: never tell a reviewer what not to flag; adjudicate false positives after they surface, and only at the cap
Capability tiering per role with explicit model on every dispatch, plus the 'turn count beats token price' heuristic
Checklists become todos one-per-item; process flows encoded as graphviz digraphs the model can follow deterministically
Calibration blocks in reviewer prompts ('only flag what would cause real problems') plus self-review that fixes inline without re-review, to damp noise and infinite polishing
Batch upfront conflict questions to the human as one message instead of mid-stream interrupts; otherwise run continuously with no 'should I continue?' check-ins
Just-in-time offering of optional rich modalities (visual companion) with a per-question modality test, never a session-wide mode switch
Platform abstraction layer: skills speak in abstract actions, per-harness reference files translate them to concrete tools
Scope check at every phase: oversized work is decomposed into sub-projects before refinement, each getting its own spec → plan → execute cycle
knowledgeWorkAnalogs: Research-brief gate: a brainstorming analog that interviews the user one question at a time to produce an approved research brief (question, scope, source types, success criteria, out-of-scope list) with a hard gate — no literature search or note-taking until the brief is approved, however 'simple' the question

Outline-as-plan: a writing-plans analog where each essay/report section is a task with exact thesis claims, the specific sources and quotes to use verbatim, and Consumes/Produces blocks (which claims a section relies on vs establishes) — 'add supporting evidence' banned as a placeholder

Section-drafting via fresh subagents: SDD analog where each section is drafted by a clean-context agent from its brief, then an independent fact-checker/editor reviews against the brief with dual verdicts (claim coverage + prose quality), distrusting the drafter's self-report, in a capped revision loop with model escalation and a final whole-document coherence review

Research ledger: an append-only lab-notebook file in the vault (sources triaged, sections drafted, findings parked with rulings) that lets a new session resume mid-project without redoing completed work — the PKM equivalent of compaction recovery
Evidence packets: a review-package analog that bundles the draft delta plus its cited passages into one file for a fact-checking agent, keeping the coordinator's context clean

Parallel literature triage: dispatching-parallel-agents analog — one agent per independent subtopic or source cluster, each with self-contained scope and an explicit output contract (structured summary + citations), followed by a synthesis pass that checks for contradictions between agents
Pre-submission self-review checklist for notes and drafts: placeholder scan, internal-contradiction check, scope check, ambiguity check — fix inline, then a human review gate before the next phase

Citation adjudication register: the parked-findings analog — unresolved source conflicts and open questions logged with explicit rulings ('two studies disagree; ruling: prefer RCT, deferred') and triaged at final review, never silently dropped

Capability tiering for knowledge tasks: cheap models for extraction/summarization/formatting, mid models for per-section drafting and fact-check re-reviews, the most capable model for synthesis, argumentation, and the final editorial review

Visual companion for structure decisions: show 2-3 candidate outlines, argument maps, or figure mockups as clickable options in a browser, logging clicks as structured events alongside the user's text feedback

Global-constraints block for writing: venue/style constraints (citation format, word limit, audience, terminology) copied verbatim from the brief into every section task so isolated drafters and reviewers share the binding rules

Decomposition-first for big questions: when a research request spans several independent questions, split into sub-briefs with an explicit ordering before refining any one — each sub-brief gets its own brief → outline → draft cycle
